thread.subject: Notice of termination for convenience - Kestrel Freight services agreement

message.text:
Dear Northwind Trading Ltd,

Pursuant to clause 14.2 of the Services Agreement dated 12 June 2024, Kestrel Freight Ltd gives ninety (90) days' written notice of termination for convenience. The agreement will therefore end on 23 November 2026.

Please confirm receipt and let us know your requirements for transition assistance under clause 14.5.

Kestrel Freight Ltd - Contracts
